Inside the jar

Gentle by design, not by dilution

🌾

Colloidal oat

The ingredient pediatricians reach for first. Calms redness and quiets the itch reflex before it starts.

💧

Squalane

A featherweight plant lipid that mirrors your skin's own oils. Moisture without the film.

🪨

Ceramides NP + AP

The mortar between your skin cells. We restock it so your barrier can do the defending.

Never: fragrance, essential oils, drying alcohols, or exfoliating acids. Your barrier is busy enough.

The ritual

Ninety seconds, twice a day

1

Mist

Two spritzes of Milk Mist on damp, just-cleansed skin.

2

Drop

Press in three Dew Drops while skin is still dewy.

3

Cloud

Seal with a pea of Cloud Cream. Go live your life.
